results.summary_before: This is an analog factory test structure for GF180mcuD, consisting of large current mirror loads that draw a multiplied reference current from selected power rails. It includes sense wires to measure voltage drops on power rails and voltage raise on the VGND rail. Testing requires a programmable current source and a precision multimeter to provide the reference current and measure the sense voltages. The design is intended for characterizing analog support on the GF180mcuD process.
results.summary: This is an analog VCO experiment using a current-starved ring oscillator. It consists of five current-starved inverter stages in a ring, followed by a buffer pair, with the output available on an analog pin and a divided digital copy on the bidirectional pins. For an input voltage in the range 0.55V to 3.3V, the oscillator output is expected to be a square wave roughly in the range of 2MHz to 400MHz. Testing requires a precision variable voltage source and an oscilloscope.
